budget_items.topic: Legal Investigation of Trust Funds Warrant Article
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrant article requested to fund legal investigation of municipal trust funds.
budget_items.quote: john bowen is requesting a warrant article to appropriate $14,252.39 for legal investigation of several long neglected municipal trust funds. the purpose is to fund approximately 40 hours of professional legal investigation to determine donor intent, verify legal compliance, and establish whether certain trust funds can be administered under their existing terms.
